texts.preamble: Krishna @ Kanhaiya vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 December, 2020 Author: Siddharth Bench: Siddharth High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 70 Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9007 of 2020 Applicant :- Krishna @ Kanhaiya Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Mohit Singh,Kaushal Kumar Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Siddharth,J. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga. Order on Criminal Misc. Exemption Application This exemption application is allowed. Order on Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Krishna @ Kanhaiya, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 439 of 2020, under Sections 272 I.P.C. and section 60 Excise Act, Police Station- Hayatnagar, District- Sambhal, during pendency of trial.
texts.facts: The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant, Krishna @ Kanhaiya, with a prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No. 439 of 2020, under Sections 272 I.P.C. and section 60 Excise Act, Police Station- Hayatnagar, District- Sambhal, during pendency of trial. Govind Mishra @ Chhotu Versus State of U.P., hence, this anticipatory bail application is being heard. Submission is that Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has been enacted by the legislature and hence the implication of the applicant under section 272, I.P.C. is unjustified. Offence under section 60 of Excise Act is bailable and triable by Magistrate. False recovery has been alleged. Applicant has definite apprehension of his arrest by the police.
texts.arguments: Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer of applicant for grant of anticipatory bail. Hence in case of his arrest the applicant is directed to be enlarged on anticipatory bail without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and considering the nature of accusations and his antecedents as per the Constitution Bench judgment of the Apex Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal vs. State (NCT of Delhi)- 2020 SCC Online SC 98 and order dated 22.05.2020 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.2609 of 2020. 3. That the applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer; 4. 5. In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail, the trial Court concerned may take appropriate action in accordance with law and judgment of Apex Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal vs. State (NCT of Delhi)- 2020 SCC Online SC 98. Krishna @ Kanhaiya vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 December, 2020
